name: Components – GOV.UK Design System
summary: Index of the GOV.UK Design System components, with guidance and coded examples for each one.
description: The components section of the GOV.UK Design System: the reusable UI parts government teams build services from, from accordions and buttons to text inputs, banners and tables. Each component page carries guidance on its use plus coded examples that render the same as in GOV.UK Frontend or the Prototype Kit. The design system's code is public under an MIT license.
contains: components include text input, checkboxes, radios, select, date input, file upload, character count
also accordion, breadcrumbs, button, tabs, table, tag, banner, footer, header, pagination, task list
guidance and coded examples for each component
renders with GOV.UK Frontend or the Prototype Kit
